episodes.synopsis: Matsuri, an exorcist ninja, encounters Shirogane, an ayakashi targeting his childhood friend, Suzu, who seems to have something "special" about her.
episodes.title: Matsuri, Suzu, and Ayakashi

episodes.synopsis: Having had Gender Swap Awakened cast on him, Matsuri enters high school as a girl. There, Shirogane attacks in a bid to take the God-Sealing Scroll, but the ayakashi Tadare goes after Suzu instead. Matsuri saves her and decides to become on of Suzu's girl friends.
episodes.title: Girl Friend

episodes.synopsis: Suzu makes Suzu-dumplings, trying to become friends with Shirogane. Matsuri sees her and reminisces about the times he admired her for her ability to befriend ayakashi. That's when they get a visit from the Lightning-Fast Exorcist Ninja, Ninokuru Souga.
episodes.title: The Speedster Exorcist Ninja

episodes.synopsis: Matsuri does his best to fit in as one of Suzu's girl friends, but he doesn't know how to act around Yayoi and Lucy. Yayoi, in turn, wants to get to know Matsuri better too, but she keeps tripping and getting up close and personal, which complciates matters. She believes Matsuri despises her now, but the cause was actually an ayakashi!
episodes.title: The Melancholy of the Ayakashi Medium

episodes.synopsis: The Suzu that showed up in Matsuri's room was actually an omokage shadow, a cloning ayakashi. What's more, it's still wandering around somewhere, which poses a real threat to Suzu's life. Matsuri and Shirogane frantically scour the town for it.
episodes.title: Omokage

episodes.synopsis: Lucy shows Matsuri and Suzu a photo she took, which seems to be a spirit photo! Captured in it is an "Ikon" a cluster of human resentment, which then proceeds to possess Lucy herself. Matsuri must find a way to exorcise the ayakashi and protect her!
episodes.title: Those Who See, and Those Who Can't

episodes.synopsis: Matsuri and Suzu receive a visit from a traveling artist, and he has a surprise or two in store for them!
episodes.title: Utagawa Garaku

episodes.synopsis: Suzu's experiment leads to Matsuri's gear malfunctioning, so they decide to pay a visit to expert artisan, Korogi Reo.
episodes.title: Her First

episodes.synopsis: UFOs, catnip, incense, and alerts galore! After the visit to the Korogi store, Matsuri has high expectations for his new ninja gear. But he doesn't expect what happens while he's trying it out!
episodes.title: An Encounter With 'Him'?

episodes.synopsis: A pretty boy transfers into school and asks Suzu for help with an ayakashi, but things take a scary turn.
episodes.title: The Enticing Boy

episodes.synopsis: The battle with the Jinyo intensifies, and Shirogane has to fend him off with Suzu in tow!
episodes.title: The Spirit of Harmony

episodes.synopsis: Having lost his powers, Shirogane now has a problem he has to deal with, and a proposition for Suzu and Matsuri.
episodes.title: Kanade Suzu, the King of Ayakashi
